preserve_product_clause: The product itself remains completely still and unchanged in every frame: its exact shape, proportions, color, material, texture, logos and printed text stay identical, with no morphing, warping or distortion. Stable camera, photorealistic advertisement cinematography, consistent composition throughout.
note_cfg1_negative_prompt_vo_dung: Da kiem chung qua job test (negative_co_tac_dung: false khi cfg=1.0). Moi rang buoc 'giu nguyen san pham' PHAI nam trong chuyen_dong (positive), khong dua vao negative_prompt.
image_prompt_skeleton: A {SCENE_CONTAINER} holds the single product from image 2, {PHYSICAL_POSE}, in the spot where the {OLD_PRODUCT_SHORT} was. {CONTACT_DETAIL}. The product is about the same size as the {OLD_PRODUCT_SHORT} and fills the same {SPACE_DESC}. The product keeps the exact shape, proportions, colors, materials, logo and all printed text of image 2{OPTIONAL_NO_OLD_SHAPE_CLAUSE}. {OPTICAL_INTERACTION_DESC}, matching image 1. The {SCENE_ELEMENTS_TO_KEEP} stay the same as image 1.
image_prompt_skeleton_note: SKELETON LAN 3 (xem note_prompt_phai_viet_tich_cuc, muc 4, day la ban DUNG NHAT tinh den nay). Day KHONG phai cau lenh edit ('Replace X') ma la MO TA TRUC TIEP canh cuoi cung, nhu dang ke lai 1 buc anh co san. {OLD_PRODUCT_SHORT} CHI xuat hien 2 lan, ca hai deu NGAN va chi de lam MOC (vi tri + kich thuoc) -- khong duoc mo ta hinh dang/chat lieu/mau cua no. {PHYSICAL_POSE}/{CONTACT_DETAIL} ta quan he VAT LY cu the (dung o dau, de len gi, bong do the nao) -- day la PHAN DAI NHAT va QUAN TRONG NHAT. {OPTICAL_INTERACTION_DESC} ta anh sang/phan chieu/khoi/nuoc TUONG TAC THAT SU len be mat san pham moi (khong chi noi 'giu nguyen anh sang') de model 'tich hop' san pham thay vi 've de' len tren. {OPTIONAL_NO_OLD_SHAPE_CLAUSE} la 1 cum phu dinh NGAN (vd ', with no glass or bottle shape remaining around it') CHI them khi da QUAN SAT THAY mot kieu loi cu the lap lai (vd con sot thuy tinh day chai) -- khong them phu dinh chung chung tu dau.
note_base_frame_tim_qua_wipe: Nhieu video mau co hieu ung quet sang (light-wipe) o dau (~frame 15-25/129, 24fps), phai do tim khung SAU khi quet xong (bo cuc day du, khong con vet quet, chua co hieu ung mau phu them) de lam base.png -- KHONG mac dinh lay frame 0.
note_dan_lai_phai_tat: Van nen luon gui 'dan_lai': false khi goi /generate/accessory_flux_lab (tham so nay mac dinh BAT trong AccessoryFluxLab_Colab, thiet ke cho ca ghep phu kien NOI CHUOI -- chi lay vung thay doi tu anh model ve, ngoai vung giu NGUYEN pixel anh goc; voi use case THAY NGUYEN CA SAN PHAM cua minh thi dan_lai khong co ly do de BAT). NHUNG: da kiem chung thuc te (golden-fireworks, 2026-10) rang tat dan_lai KHONG tu no sua duoc loi 'giu nguyen hinh vat the cu' -- test voi dan_lai=false van ra y het hinh chai. Dung coi day la 'thuoc chua' chinh, chi la ve sinh tham so nen lam.
note_prompt_phai_viet_tich_cuc: LICH SU 3 LAN SUA (2026-10) -- DOC HET CA 3, MOI LAN RUT RA 1 LOP BAI HOC KHAC NHAU, KHONG LAN NAO PHU DINH HOAN TOAN LAN TRUOC: (1) Skeleton GOC mo dau bang 'the {OLD_PRODUCT_DESC} is completely removed, including..., and nothing of its shape remains' -- phu dinh nang, lai nhet khai niem vat CU vao dau cau (trong so cao) -> nhieu template giu lai hinh vat cu. (2) Sua thanh cau 'tich cuc' mo ta vi tri/ty le san pham MOI, bo het phu dinh -- CAI THIEN 1 so ca (dome-product voi SAN PHAM CU: giay bien mat) nhung VAN THAT BAI tren ca kho nhat luc do (golden-fireworks voi iPhone: 5/5 lan thu deu ra hinh chai). (3) NGUOI DUNG tu thu cau LENH TRUC TIEP ngan gon 'Replace the entire X...' -- SUA DUOC golden-fireworks (chai->lon Coca, 2 hinh tru gan giong nhau) nhung khi doi sang san pham la LON COCA-COLA thi lai THAT BAI tren dome-product (giay->lon, 2 hinh rat khac nhau: giay bi 'dan da' nhan Coca len thay vi doi hinh). Tuc 'Replace' chi hieu qua khi hinh dang vat cu/moi TUONG DONG; khac biet lon thi van fail y het phu dinh goc. (4) NGUOI DUNG tu viet VA XAC NHAN cong thuc THAT SU tong quat, sua duoc ca ca kho nhat (giay->lon Coca): KHONG dung cau lenh edit, ma MO TA TRUC TIEP canh cuoi cung nhu dang ke mot buc anh co san (vi du: 'A glass display dome on a peach pedestal holds the single product from image 2, standing upright..., in the spot where the shoe was. The product rests on its base..., with a soft contact shadow beneath it... The curved glass of the dome in front of the product shows soft reflections...'). Day la skeleton HIEN TAI (xem image_prompt_skeleton) -- chi tiet cau truc o note cua no. KET LUAN CUOI: dieu quyet dinh khong phai 'phu dinh hay tich cuc' (lan 1 vs 2) cung khong chi la 'co lenh Replace' (lan 3), ma la MUC DO CHI TIET cua phan mo ta QUAN HE VAT LY + QUANG HOC cua san pham MOI voi canh -- cau cang ngan (du la 'Replace' hay 'tich cuc') thi cang de bi model quay ve hinh dang vat cu khi 2 hinh dang khac biet lon; mo ta dai, cu the, nhu dang tuong thuat 1 buc anh that, moi la cach tong quat nhat tung kiem chung duoc.
